name: Group Anagrams
description: Groups strings that are anagrams of each other by using sorted string as a hash key.
aim: Cluster anagrams together: sort each string as a canonical key, group all strings with the same sorted key.
howItWorks: For each string: sort its characters to get a canonical key
Use sorted string as hash map key
Append original string to the group for its key
Return all groups (values of the map)

time.bestCase: n strings each of max length L

complexity.spaceDescription: Store all strings in hash map groups

whenToUse: Find all anagrams in a list of words
alternatives: Character frequency tuple as key — avoids sorting, still O(n×L)

defaultInput: eat, tea, tan, ate, nat, bat
inputHint: A list of words separated by commas.
